HEADER.TITLE: Meta Templates
HEADER.DESCRIPTION: Manage the WhatsApp Business templates registered with Meta. Browse, filter and inspect each template's structure and approval status here.

SYNC.FAILED: Could not refresh templates from Meta. Please try again shortly.

DETAIL.MEDIA_HEADER_NOTE: Media header ({format}). The actual image / video / document is set at send time.
DETAIL.EDIT_DISABLED_REASON: Only APPROVED templates can be edited (current status: {status}). Delete and create a new one to change it.

NOTIFICATIONS.STATUS_CHANGED: Meta updated the status of template "{name}" to {status}.

ANALYTICS.TITLE: Usage
ANALYTICS.EMPTY: No sends of this template in the selected period.

DELETE.TITLE: Delete template
DELETE.DESCRIPTION: Are you sure you want to delete "{name}" on Meta? This removes every language variant of this template and cannot be undone. If the template is used by an active campaign, Meta will refuse the deletion.
DELETE.FAILED: Could not delete the template. Please try again shortly.

EMPTY.NO_CLOUD_INBOX: This account has no WhatsApp Cloud inbox connected yet.
EMPTY.NO_TEMPLATES: No templates registered on this inbox yet. Create one on business.facebook.com — full creation flow inside AurisChat is coming soon.
EMPTY.NO_MATCH: No templates match the current filters.

ERRORS.FETCH_FAILED: Could not load templates. Please try again.

NEW.TITLE: New Meta Template
NEW.DESCRIPTION: Compose a new WhatsApp Business template and submit it to Meta for approval. Once submitted it appears in the list as Pending — approval usually takes minutes to a few hours.

FIELDS.NAME: Template name
FIELDS.NAME_HINT: Lowercase letters, numbers and underscores only. Must be unique on this inbox.
FIELDS.NAME_IMMUTABLE: Name, language and inbox cannot be changed after creation (Meta rule).

CATEGORY_HINT.MARKETING: Marketing: Use this template to send engaging marketing messages that promote your business, highlight new products or services, and share important information with your audience. Good for welcome messages, newsletters, offers, coupons, catalogs, and business hours.
CATEGORY_HINT.UTILITY: Utility: Use this template to send essential utility messages that facilitate transactions, manage accounts, and improve the customer experience. Examples include order confirmations, account updates, receipts, appointment reminders, and billing notifications.
CATEGORY_HINT.AUTHENTICATION: Authentication: Use this template to send secure authentication messages that protect the integrity of customer transactions and logins. Examples include one-time passwords for login verification, account recovery codes, and other sensitive authentication requests.

FIELDS.HEADER_TOGGLE_HINT: Text (short heading) or an image (JPG/PNG up to 5 MB).
FIELDS.HEADER_IMAGE_HINT: Up to 5 MB. Meta uses this exact image on every send of the template.
FIELDS.HEADER_IMAGE_TOO_LARGE: The image must be 5 MB or less.
FIELDS.HEADER_IMAGE_UPLOAD_FAILED: Could not upload the image to Meta. Try again in a moment.
FIELDS.HEADER_TEXT_PLACEHOLDER: Short heading, up to one {'{{'}1{'}}'} variable
FIELDS.HEADER_HINT_WITH_COUNT: Up to 60 characters, at most one variable. ({count}/{max})
FIELDS.HEADER_SAMPLE: Sample value for the header variable
FIELDS.BODY_HINT: Use numbered variables ({'{{'}1{'}}'}, {'{{'}2{'}}'}) or named ones ({'{{'}name{'}}'}, {'{{'}date{'}}'}). Do not mix both styles in the same template.
FIELDS.BODY_HINT_WITH_COUNT: Use numbered variables ({'{{'}1{'}}'}, {'{{'}2{'}}'}) or named ones ({'{{'}name{'}}'}, {'{{'}date{'}}'}). Do not mix both styles in the same template. ({count}/{max})
FIELDS.SAMPLES_DESCRIPTION: Meta requires a realistic example for each variable so reviewers can approve the template.

VAR_ISSUES.BODY_MIXED: The body text mixes numbered ({'{{'}1{'}}'}) and named ({'{{'}name{'}}'}) variables. Meta rejects templates that use both styles — pick one.
VAR_ISSUES.HEADER_MIXED: The header text mixes numbered ({'{{'}1{'}}'}) and named ({'{{'}name{'}}'}) variables. Meta rejects templates that use both styles — pick one.
VAR_ISSUES.HEADER_BODY_MISMATCH: Header and body are using different variable styles. Use numbered variables or named variables in both — not a mix.

FIELDS.FOOTER_TOGGLE_HINT: Short static text below the body, no variables.
FIELDS.FOOTER_PLACEHOLDER: e.g. Reply STOP to opt out
FIELDS.BUTTONS_HINT: Up to 3 quick replies OR up to 2 URL + 1 phone.

NEW.SUCCESS: Template submitted to Meta. It will appear as Pending until Meta approves it.
NEW.ERROR_GENERIC: Could not create the template. Please review the fields and try again.

EDIT.TITLE: Edit Meta Template
EDIT.DESCRIPTION: Update a template registered on Meta. Editing body / header / footer / buttons sends the template back to Pending for reapproval. Name, language and inbox cannot be changed.
EDIT.SUCCESS: Template updated on Meta. If you changed body / header / footer / buttons, it will be Pending until reapproval.
EDIT.ERROR_GENERIC: Could not update the template. Please review the fields and try again.
EDIT.NOT_FOUND: This template is no longer available on this inbox.
EDIT.NOT_EDITABLE: Meta only allows edits on APPROVED templates. This one is {status}, so it cannot be edited from here — delete it and create a new one to change it.

COMING_SOON.MESSAGE: Meta template management will land here soon. For now, keep using business.facebook.com.
